obligations.statement: The product must provide a pedal surface that the user's foot can press.
derivation_premises: A signal is sent when the pedal is pressed; hence there must be a pedal surface that the foot can press.

obligations.statement: The product must translate a press on the pedal surface into a signal sent to the machine.
derivation_premises: Pressing the pedal must cause a signal; hence the press must be linked to a signaling mechanism.

obligations.statement: The product must allow the pedal to move from rest to a pressed position when the foot presses.
derivation_premises: Clear motion is required for the pedal to be pressed.

obligations.statement: The product must return the pedal to its resting position using only internal means when the foot is removed.
derivation_premises: The pedal must return on its own; hence an internal restoring mechanism is necessary.

obligations.statement: The product must maintain a defined resting position and return to that position each time.
derivation_premises: The requirement refers to 'its resting position', so a consistent rest configuration must exist.

obligations.statement: The product must resist sideways motion of the pedal when a sideways force is applied, without preventing pressing.
derivation_premises: The pedal must not move sideways when brushed, but must still move when pressed; hence degrees of freedom must allow only the intended motion.

obligations.statement: The product must have a supporting interface to the workbench surface to react applied loads.
derivation_premises: The pedal must rest on the workbench; loads must be reacted to the environment.

obligations.statement: The product must provide a restoring force or torque to return the pedal to rest.
derivation_premises: Springs, gravity, or other means could supply the restoring action; the principle family differs.

obligations.statement: The product must guide the pedal so that it moves in the intended direction (e.g., vertical) and not sideways.
derivation_premises: The pedal must press down and resist sideways motion, requiring a constraint that permits only a single degree of freedom.

obligations.statement: The product must include a mechanism to transmit the pedal motion to a signal (e.g., electrical switch, mechanical valve).
derivation_premises: A signal must be generated; the specific transduction mechanism is a free choice.

obligations.statement: The product must allow service access to the foot pedal for maintenance or adjustment.
derivation_premises: The scenario includes service, so the pedal must be accessible for maintenance.

obligations.statement: The pedal must have a stable resting position that is kinematically defined so that it returns to the same place each time.
derivation_premises: Returning to 'resting position' implies a repeatable configuration; different mechanisms (spring, gravity, detent) achieve this differently.

obligations.statement: The product must have a defined path for the pedal that avoids unintended motions (e.g., sideways brushing).
derivation_premises: The pedal must not move sideways; hence its motion must be constrained to a single path.

obligations.statement: The product must provide a ground or support to react the press force and any other loads to the workbench.
derivation_premises: Loads must be reacted; the workbench is outside the product boundary.
